headline: Axis Direct names 10 stocks with up to 48 percent upside for Samvat 2083
summary: Axis Direct has selected ten technical stocks for Diwali and Samvat 2083, projecting up to 48 percent upside potential based on long-term performance charts. The recommended portfolio includes Aurobindo Pharma, Hindustan Aeronautics, IOL Chemicals, Jyoti CNC Automation, Karnataka Bank, Dr. Lal Path Labs, Mayur Uniquoters, and Shivalik Bimetal Controls. These selections highlight technical strength and growth prospects for the coming year. Indian retail investors tracking festive brokerage picks can evaluate these names for potential portfolio additions.
why_it_matters: New brokerage recommendations to consider for festive portfolio additions.

headline: Axis Direct releases Diwali stock picks with 48% upside potential
summary: Axis Direct has released a list of 12 technical stock picks for the upcoming Samvat 2083. headline: Mayur Uniquoters acquires a 26 percent stake in Bhadla Mini Grid Solar 6
summary: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd has announced an investment of up to Rs 191.40 lakhs to acquire a 26 percent equity stake in Bhadla Mini Grid Solar 6 Pvt Ltd. The investment will be made in one or more tranches through equity subscription, making the solar entity an associate company. For retail investors, this transaction represents a small capital deployment into renewable energy infrastructure for captive power consumption or diversification. Given the minor outlay relative to Mayur Uniquoters' overall scale, the direct financial impact on the company's balance sheet is limited.
why_it_matters: Minor green energy investment has negligible near-term stock impact.

headline: Mayur Uniquoters files financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd has formally submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the specified period. Retail investors can review these figures to assess the company's operational health and earnings trajectory.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for review

headline: Ashutosh Pandey resigns as Senior Management Personnel of Mayur Uniquoters
summary: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd has informed the stock exchange that Mr Ashutosh Pandey has resigned from his position as Senior Management Personnel. The resignation will take effect from October 09, 2026. Such management changes in listed companies are routine corporate disclosures. Retail investors should note this executive transition as part of tracking the company's internal leadership stability.
whats_next: Company announcement on a replacement for the SMP role.
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with minimal direct impact on share price.
